findings.current: “Though you’re no Grand Mage, you can freely use subspace without having learned any magic at all. And that extraordinary healing power… Yes, it’s hard to explain without divine favor.”
findings.defect: “Though you’re no Grand Mage” weakens the contrast: Jin has not learned even a single spell, let alone become a Grand Mage.
findings.rationale: 대마법사는커녕 sets Grand Mage beyond the more basic threshold of learning any magic.
findings.replacement: “You can use subspace freely without ever learning a single spell, let alone becoming a Grand Mage. And that extraordinary healing power… Yes, it’s hard to explain without divine favor.”
findings.source: - 대마법사는커녕 그 어떤 마법조차 배우지 않았음에도 아공간(亞空間)을 자유자재로 사용하고, 그토록 대단한 치유의 힘이라면…….

findings.current:
But he knew all too well that even this terrible acidity could no longer harm a single hair on his head.

And he knew the same was true of the owner of the silver blood flowing like a small river.
findings.defect: The draft says Morgoth is also immune to the acid. The source says Morgoth also knows the acid cannot harm Jin.
findings.rationale: 역시도 carries forward the act of knowing, not the property of being unharmed.
findings.replacement:
But he knew all too well that even this terrible acidity could no longer harm a single hair on his head.

So did the owner of the silver blood flowing like a small river.
findings.source:
그러나 이제는 이토록 지독한 산성(酸性)조차도 자신의 털끝 하나 상하게 할 수 없음을, 그는 잘 알고 있었다.

마치 작은 강처럼 흐르고 있는 이 은빛 핏물의 주인 역시도.

findings.current: “We fought, and he won. A helplessness and humiliation I’d never known before crushed me.”
findings.defect: 패배감 is the feeling of defeat, not humiliation; the following narration introduces humiliation separately.
findings.rationale: 무력감과 패배감 names helplessness and defeat, while 치욕 appears in the next paragraph.
findings.replacement: “We fought, and he won. A helplessness and sense of defeat I’d never known before crushed me.”
findings.source: - 우리는 싸웠고, 그가 승리했다. 지금껏 느껴본 적 없는 무력감과 패배감이 나를 짓눌렀지.

findings.current: With the power he gained, he became a Demon Duke, succeeding Asmodeus.
findings.defect: “Succeeding Asmodeus” implies Morgoth replaced him. The source places Morgoth next after Asmodeus in the Demon Realm’s hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 아스모데우스의 뒤를 잇는 describes standing behind Asmodeus, not inheriting his position.
findings.replacement: With the power he gained, he became a Demon Duke second only to Asmodeus.
findings.source: 더욱 강력해진 힘을 바탕으로 아스모데우스의 뒤를 잇는 마계의 대공으로 거듭났다.

findings.current: “Some lowly human defeated Asmodeus? At first, I couldn’t help but laugh.”
findings.defect: The draft reverses Morgoth’s reaction: he did not find the claim funny.
findings.rationale: 우습지도 않더군 negates amusement rather than describing laughter.
findings.replacement: “A mere human defeated Asmodeus? At first, I didn’t even find it funny.”
findings.source: - 한낱 인간 따위가 아스모데우스를 쓰러트렸다니, 처음에는 우습지도 않더군.

findings.defect: “Shuddered” suggests fear or revulsion where Morgoth is thrilled by news that revives his interest.
findings.rationale: 전율했다 is followed by the news rekindling Morgoth’s long-faded interest.

findings.source:
- 당신은 [화룡신창]에 대한 깊은 깨달음을 바탕으로 자신만의 길을 개척했습니다.

- 초절정 무공, [화룡신창]에 새로운 초식이 추가됩니다. 무공에 담긴 위력과 묘리가 한층 강해집니다.

- 세 번째 초식, [개천]이 등록되었습니다. 이는 [열화문]의 역사에 새겨질 것이며, 먼 훗날의 후인들은 당신의 이름과 위업을 기억할 것입니다.

- 놀라운 업적, [온고지신溫故知新]을 달성했습니다!

- [열화문]의 무공에 대한 이해도가 깊어졌습니다. 관련 무공을 사용할 시, 기의 수발이 보다 자유로워지며 소모되는 공력의 양이 감소합니다.

- [염화일로]의 경지가 상승합니다!

- [화염신장]의 경지가 상승합니다!

findings.current:

findings.source:
- 축하합니다. [열화신공]과 [기감]의 경지가 9성에 도달했습니다!

- 이는 새로운 경지로 이어져 있는 계단인 동시에, 당신의 앞을 가로막은 거대한 벽이기도 합니다. 부디 무운(武運)을 빕니다.

- [심안]에 대한 깨달음을 얻었습니다. 해당 능력은 특정 조건을 만족한 상황에서만 발동되며, 매우 극심한 피로도를 유발합니다.

findings.defect: The System notice retains square brackets around the status effect.
findings.rationale: The binding System-panel format excludes square brackets around UI terms.
findings.replacement: > Status effect Trance has been lifted.

summary: The draft changes who is vulnerable to the acidic blood, reverses Morgoth’s reaction to Asmodeus’s defeat, and misstates Morgoth’s position in the Demon Realm. The System panel also retains square brackets contrary to the binding format.
